subject: Catalyst Labs — accelerator credit eligibility & packaging escalation
messages:
From: Hannah Green <hannah@catalystlabs.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@catalystlabs.ai
Date: 2026-10-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Accelerator credit request + packaging question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Catalyst Labs is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the dedicated conversion story. Our accelerator cohort kicks off Nov 1 and we have a small ask: the founders in our program need a one-off promotional pool that can be applied across text generation and embeddings (some teams will use the API for synthetic data generation + embedding pipelines).

Two quick questions:
- Can promo credits be scoped to apply to multiple product surfaces (generation + embeddings) under one account?
- Can we get an exception to extend the 30-day credit expiration to 90 days for cohort participants? Several teams are pre-launch and need runway.

We'd like to finalize packaging this week so we can include it in our onboarding email. Happy to share a short usage forecast — attaching a high-level sheet here.

Thanks,
Hannah
Founder Partnerships | Catalyst Labs
[Attachment: catalyst-usage-forecast.xlsx - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Green <hannah@catalystlabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-22T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit request + packaging question

Hi Hannah — great to meet you yesterday.

Short answers: we can scope promo credits across endpoints under the same account, but the accounting and billing rules differ for embeddings vs generation (rate per unit varies). Extending expiration to 90 days is not standard, but I can escalate for a one-off for your cohort.

Marissa (pricing) — can you propose a packaging that accommodates mixed-surface credits + a 90-day window?
Laura (billing) — any accounting flags if we push expiration from 30 -> 90 for a cohort of ~45 teams?

I'll wait for the proposal and we can loop legal for addendum sign-off.

Cheers,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Green <hannah@catalystlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit request + packaging question

On Fri, Oct 22, 2026 at 9:07 AM Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Short answers: we can scope promo credits across endpoints under the same account...

Thanks for the ping. Hannah — based on the usage forecast you sent, here's a pragmatic option we can offer without changing platform accounting:

Option A (recommended) — Cohort Promo Pool
- One pooled promo credit balance attached to the Catalyst account (applies to generation + embeddings).
- Credits redeemable by sub-accounts (one per cohort team).
- Expiry: 90 days for this cohort only (one-time exception).
- Quantum: 150,000 generation tokens + 50,000 embedding units (we modeled consumption in the attached sheet).
- Visibility: consolidated consumption dashboard for Catalyst admin.

Notes / requirements:
- We require a signed promo addendum (legal) and a short cohort roster to provision sub-accounts.
- This exception is single-use and tied to deal DL-2026-0912.

If that looks OK to you we can produce the promo_addendum_v1.pdf and route to your legal for a quick sign (DocuSign). Laura, any concerns on invoicing or tax treatment if Catalyst is the paying org but credits are consumed by multiple sub-accounts?

Thanks — happy to tweak numbers if you want a larger pool for early-stage heavy-usage teams.

Regards,
Marissa
Principal Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: promo_pricing_notes.txt - text/plain]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Green <hannah@catalystlabs.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Accelerator credit request + packaging question

Thanks team — good thread.

Marissa's Option A is fine from an accounting perspective with two minor operational asks:
1) Invoice flow: Catalyst will be billed as the parent account for any overage beyond the pooled credits. We'll include a brief line item called "Cohort Promo Pool (DL-2026-0912)" on monthly invoices.
2) Tax/AR: Need Catalyst's billing address and tax ID before activation.

Attached: promo_addendum_v1.pdf (standard one-time exception addendum) and the populated usage forecast sheet. Hannah — when you confirm the roster and billing info I will:
- Provision the pooled balance and create sub-accounts for each team.
- Attach the promo metadata to the account so credits are consumed in the combined pool.

Next steps:
- Hannah: please review the attached addendum and send billing details + roster.
- Catalyst legal: if you prefer, we can route via DocuSign (link below) for a 2-signature flow.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/s/abc-apply-promo
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/12345

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
